about.heroDesc1: CLINKA is an engineering technology platform focused on connecting architecture, structural engineering, and construction workflows into one smart ecosystem.
about.heroDesc2: CLINKA is an engineering technology platform built to connect clients, architects, civil engineers, MEP professionals, BIM specialists, and construction teams in one integrated ecosystem.
about.heroDesc3: We simplify the journey from an empty plot to completed engineering deliverables — making professional engineering services faster, safer, and more transparent.
about.missionDesc: To modernize engineering and construction workflows in Egypt and the Middle East through technology, trusted collaboration, and accessible engineering services.
about.visionDesc: To become the leading digital infrastructure for engineering and construction across the Middle East — where every project starts, grows, and gets delivered.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.subtitle: How we handle your information on CLINKA.
legal.privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
legal.privacy.s1.p1: CLINKA (“we”, “us”, “our”) operates an engineering marketplace that connects clients with verified civil and architectural engineers. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you use our website and services.
legal.privacy.s2.title: 2. Information we collect
legal.privacy.s2.p1: Account information: name, email address, password (stored in hashed form), role (client, engineer, or admin), profile photo, and optional Google account identifier if you sign in with Google.
legal.privacy.s2.p2: Platform activity: project listings, bids, messages and attachments, payment records processed through Paymob, reviews, notifications, and support requests. Engineers may also provide specialty, nationality, bio, portfolio items, and verification documents (such as college ID, certificate, or syndicate card) for credential review.
legal.privacy.s3.title: 3. How we use your information
legal.privacy.s3.p1: We use your data to create and manage your account, match clients with engineers, process bids and contracts, facilitate escrow payments, deliver in-platform messaging, verify engineer credentials, send service notifications, prevent abuse (including contact-info sharing in chat), and improve the platform.
legal.privacy.s3.p2: We do not sell your personal information to third parties for advertising purposes.
legal.privacy.s4.title: 4. Sharing and service providers
legal.privacy.s4.p1: We share data only as needed to operate CLINKA: with payment processor Paymob for checkout and escrow transactions, with our secure file hosting infrastructure for uploaded images and documents, with email providers for verification and account emails, and with infrastructure providers that host our application and database.
legal.privacy.s4.p2: Other users may see information you choose to make visible on the platform—for example, your public engineer profile, project details you post, bids you submit, and messages sent within a project conversation.
legal.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data retention
legal.privacy.s5.p1: We retain account and transaction records for as long as your account is active and as required to provide the service, resolve disputes, enforce our terms, and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account by contacting us through the Help Center.
legal.privacy.s6.title: 6. Your rights
legal.privacy.s6.p1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or to object to certain processing. You can update much of your profile information in Settings.
legal.privacy.s6.p2: To exercise other rights or ask questions about this policy, contact us via the Help Center at /help or email our support team.
legal.privacy.s7.title: 7. Cookies and authentication
legal.privacy.s7.p1: We use HTTP-only cookies to keep you signed in securely. These cookies are required for account authentication and are not used for third-party advertising trackers.
legal.privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to this policy
legal.privacy.s8.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of CLINKA after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.subtitle: Rules for using the CLINKA engineering marketplace.
legal.terms.s1.title: 1. Agreement to terms
legal.terms.s1.p1: By creating an account or using CLINKA, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
legal.terms.s2.title: 2. What CLINKA provides
legal.terms.s2.p1: CLINKA is an online marketplace that helps clients post engineering projects, receive bids from engineers, communicate in project-based chat, fund work through escrow payments, and leave reviews. CLINKA is not a construction company, employer, or licensed engineering firm—we facilitate connections and payments between independent users.
legal.terms.s3.title: 3. Accounts and eligibility
legal.terms.s3.p1: You must provide accurate registration information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account. You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter contracts in your jurisdiction.
legal.terms.s3.p2: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, provide false information, or pose a risk to other users or the platform.
legal.terms.s4.title: 4. Client responsibilities
legal.terms.s4.p1: Clients are responsible for posting clear, lawful project scopes and budgets, reviewing bids in good faith, funding agreed work through the platform payment flow, and releasing payment only after reviewing deliverables.
legal.terms.s4.p2: Clients must not use CLINKA to solicit off-platform payments or circumvent platform fees and protections.
legal.terms.s5.title: 5. Engineer responsibilities
legal.terms.s5.p1: Engineers must submit truthful credentials for verification, provide accurate bids, deliver professional work as agreed, and maintain an up-to-date profile and portfolio.
legal.terms.s5.p2: Only engineers with approved verification may bid on projects. CLINKA may approve or reject verification documents at its discretion.
legal.terms.s6.title: 6. Projects, bids, and contracts
legal.terms.s6.p1: When a client accepts a bid, a working relationship is formed directly between the client and the engineer. CLINKA provides tools to manage that relationship but is not a party to the underlying engineering services contract.
legal.terms.s6.p2: Project status, milestones, and deliverables should be agreed in writing within the platform chat. CLINKA is not responsible for disputes about scope, quality, or timelines beyond the escrow and review tools we provide.
legal.terms.s7.title: 7. Payments and escrow
legal.terms.s7.p1: Payments are processed through Paymob. Funds for accepted projects are held in escrow until the client approves release. CLINKA charges a platform commission on transactions as disclosed at checkout.
legal.terms.s7.p2: Chargebacks, failed payments, and refunds are handled according to our payment partner's rules and applicable law. Users must not attempt to move payments off-platform to avoid fees or protections.
legal.terms.s8.title: 8. Messaging and conduct
legal.terms.s8.p1: Project conversations are provided for professional collaboration. Sharing personal contact information to bypass the platform (phone numbers, external emails, social handles, etc.) is prohibited and may result in automatic suspension.
legal.terms.s8.p2: You must not harass, threaten, spam, upload malware, or post unlawful content. We may scan messages and attachments to enforce these rules and keep users safe.
legal.terms.s9.title: 9. Reviews
legal.terms.s9.p1: After a project is completed, clients may leave honest ratings and comments. Reviews must be factual and related to the work performed. We may remove reviews that are abusive, fraudulent, or unrelated to the project.
legal.terms.s10.title: 10. Prohibited use
legal.terms.s10.p1: You may not use CLINKA for illegal projects, impersonation, credential fraud, scraping or automated abuse, interference with platform security, or any activity that harms other users or CLINKA's operations.
legal.terms.s11.title: 11. Limitation of liability
legal.terms.s11.p1: CLINKA is provided “as is” to the fullest extent permitted by law. We are not liable for engineering outcomes, construction results, indirect damages, or losses arising from user-to-user dealings. Our total liability for any claim related to the service is limited to the fees you paid to CLINKA in the twelve months before the claim.
legal.terms.s12.title: 12. Changes and contact
legal.terms.s12.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance. Questions or disputes should first be submitted through the Help Center at /help.
legal.security.title: Security
legal.security.subtitle: How CLINKA protects your account, payments, and communications.
legal.security.s1.title: 1. Our security commitment
legal.security.s1.p1: CLINKA is built for professional engineering work where trust matters. We combine technical safeguards, identity verification, and platform policies to reduce fraud and protect clients and engineers.
legal.security.s2.title: 2. Account and authentication security
legal.security.s2.p1: Passwords are stored using industry-standard hashing and are never stored in plain text. Sessions use signed JWT tokens delivered via secure HTTP-only cookies to reduce exposure to cross-site scripting.
legal.security.s2.p2: You can sign in with email and password or Google OAuth where enabled. Enable a strong, unique password and do not share your login credentials with anyone.
legal.security.s3.title: 3. Engineer identity verification
legal.security.s3.p1: Before engineers can bid, CLINKA admins review submitted documents such as college ID, professional certificates, or syndicate membership cards.
legal.security.s3.p2: Verified engineers receive an approved status on the platform. We may revoke verification if documents are found to be false or expired.
legal.security.s4.title: 4. Payments and escrow
legal.security.s4.p1: Client payments for accepted projects are processed through Paymob, a licensed payment gateway. Card and payment details are handled by the gateway—not stored on CLINKA servers.
legal.security.s4.p2: Funds remain in escrow until the client releases payment after reviewing deliverables, reducing the risk of paying for incomplete work.
legal.security.s5.title: 5. Messaging safety
legal.security.s5.p1: In-platform chat is monitored for attempts to share off-platform contact details, which can be used to bypass escrow and verification protections.
legal.security.s5.p2: Users who violate messaging rules may receive temporary suspensions. Admins can review reported conversations when investigating abuse.
legal.security.s6.title: 6. Infrastructure and data
legal.security.s6.p1: Application data is stored in secured databases with access restricted to authorized systems. File uploads (profile images, portfolios, chat attachments, verification documents) are stored on CLINKA's secured server storage with access controls appropriate to their use and can be delivered through a CDN cache in front of the API.
legal.security.s7.title: 7. Your responsibilities
legal.security.s7.p1: Keep your device and browser updated, log out on shared computers, and report suspicious account activity immediately.
legal.security.s7.p2: Never send passwords, payment card numbers, or one-time codes to other users in chat or email. CLINKA staff will never ask for your password.
legal.security.s8.title: 8. Reporting security issues
legal.security.s8.p1: If you discover a vulnerability or security concern, contact us through the Help Center at /help or email our support team. We investigate all good-faith reports promptly.
